page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 72 physical cores, utilizing a single thread per core configuration. The underlying hardware is based on the x86_64 architecture, specifically employing Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 288.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 33 Gbps, which facilitates high-throughput data transfers between instances and external services. The lack of integrated local storage represents a tradeoff, as disk I/O performance will depend entirely on the attached network storage configuration, though the 33 Gbps network baseline helps mitigate potential bottlenecks.

Given its balanced resource profile and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is suited for enterprise applications, web serving, distributed caching, and medium-scale database hosting. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a cost-efficient hardware profile for workloads requiring consistent, non-burstable compute performance without the premium cost associated with memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated instances.
